question: In watershed_reach_integrity_scores.csv, among reach records with a non-blank Overall, Habitat and Contact Recreation score, how many have a Habitat score at least 20 points higher than their Contact Recreation score?
solve_py:
import os,pandas as pd
D=os.environ.get('DATA_DIR','/app/data')
d=pd.read_csv(D+'/watershed_reach_integrity_scores.csv')
d=d.dropna(subset=['Overall','Habitat','Contact Recreation'])
print(int(((d.Habitat-d['Contact Recreation'])>=20).sum()))
